goal: pdp_split_dreg_20261011: replay the split/hybrid PDP stage diagnostic on K_0/GF(2^13), l = 4
statement: Replay objective, unfunded. Claim: on the Koblitz curve icv1-f2m13-t181-515ee569 (K_0 / GF(2^13)) with factor base the standard subspace span(1, z, z^2, z^3), for the four seeded targets of seed 20261011, the unsplit S4 system and the S3-chain split (plans [3] and [2,1]), each with g = 0, 2, 4 guessed Boolean unknowns, solved by the repository's F4 (pq_f4_f2::groebner_basis_f4), reach the per-run solving degrees and F4 word-XOR counts in `profile`, find exactly the decompositions an exhaustive enumeration finds (all_complete_and_exact), and total word_xors_total XORs and verified_total verified decompositions. Wall time is deliberately not a field. Reproduce from a checkout of github.com/aburan28/crypto on branch claude/pdp-split-dreg (protocol commit 51bb1dc5) after `cargo build --release --bin pdp_split_dreg`; protocol: research/pdp_split_dreg_20261011/PROTOCOL.md.
